Flaviker, a historic Italian ceramic tile brand set up in the Emilia region in the late 1960s, produces indoor and outdoor full-body porcelain tiles for architectural applications.
Following its acquisition by ABK GROUP in 2007, it changed direction and focused in particular on design and technological innovation.
Flaviker combines contemporary characteristics with a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic while remaining constantly attentive to the latest trends.
A world-famous Italian ceramic producer, Flaviker is renowned for its quality, innovation, eco-sustainability and constantly evolving style. It specialises in contemporary porcelain surfaces, delivering high-performance products with cutting-edge aesthetics and technology in a constantly expanding range of sizes and finishes. Drawing from multiple inspirations, the sheer breadth of its range makes it particularly suitable for complete residential and public projects. Its architectural surfaces reproduce an array of different materials including concrete, stone, marble and plain colours and are ideal for use both as individual wall coverings and as mix-and-match solutions for a total crossover effect.
Each individual collection becomes a highly versatile tool in the hands of an architect, bringing a distinctive look to residential projects and public and commercial spaces. Utilising the manufacturing expertise acquired throughout its history, Flaviker combines aesthetic excellence with technological innovation to offer sizes ranging from large tiles to flexible ceramic planks and extra-thick slabs for outdoor use.

description_text:
Boston House 03
High quality Wooden House created references to a real life building located in boston, with much detail to it, such as dirty wooden white wooden planks and pillars, roof and a detailed entrance with a door, and windows.
The house is inspired to be used in open world games, but note! that this is not an enterable house,but perfect for decoration on the vast landscape, or in city environments.
Low Poly Triangles - 3518 Triangles - 2836 Vertices
4096x4096 TGA/PNG/JPG Textures - Specular & Normal
Textures is created using Photoshop, and has a Diffuse, Normal & Specular to its base.
Work around with its material, and you can easy find the right settings for it.
File Formats :
.Max2016.Max2015.Max2014.Max2013.FBX.OBJ.3DS.DAE

Very detailed model of a rock suitable for any kind of visualization or other types of artwork. It's realistic and comes complete with shader. It has very dense geometry so you can use it even for close-up shots but it's not usable for games or other real-time projects, it would need to be optimised for such purposes.

Capacity at completion: 64000. Maximum capacity: 69000 (1949). Present day capacity: 51,177.
It is the home stadium of football club Feyenoord, one of the traditional top teams in the Netherlands. It has also long been one of the home grounds of the Dutch national team, having hosted over 150 international matches, with the first one being a match against Belgium on May 2, 1937. description_text:
Daytona International Speedway is a race track in Daytona Beach, Florida, United States. Since opening in 1959, it has been the home of the Daytona 500, the most prestigious race in NASCAR. In addition to NASCAR, the track also hosts races of ARCA, AMA Superbike, USCC, SCCA, and Motocross. The track features multiple layouts including the primary 2.5-mile (4.0 km) high-speed tri-oval, a 3.56-mile (5.73 km) sports car course, a 2.95-mile (4.75 km) motorcycle course, and a 1,320-foot (400 m) karting and motorcycle flat-track. The track's 180-acre (73 ha) infield includes the 29-acre (12 ha) Lake Lloyd, which has hosted powerboat racing. The speedway is owned and operated by International Speedway Corporation.
The track was built in 1959 by NASCAR founder William "Bill" France, Sr. to host racing that was held at the former Daytona Beach Road Course. His banked design permitted higher speeds and gave fans a better view of the cars. Lights were installed around the track in 1998, and today it is the third-largest single lit outdoor sports facility. The speedway has been renovated three times, with the infield renovated in 2004 and the track repaved in 1978 and 2010.
On January 22, 2013, the track unveiled artist depictions of a renovated speedway. On July 5, 2013, ground was broken on the project that removed backstretch seating and completely redevelop the frontstretch seating. The renovation to the speedway was constructed by Design-Builder Barton Malow Company in partnership with Rossetti Architects. The project, named "Daytona Rising", was completed in January 2016, and cost US $400 million, placing emphasis on improving fan experience with five expanded and redesigned fan entrances (called "injectors"), as well as wider and more comfortable seating with more restrooms and concession stands. After the renovations were completed, the track's grandstands include 101,000 permanent seats with the ability to increase permanent seating to 125,000.[1][2] The project was finished before the start of Speedweeks in 2016.

description_text:
Continuing our ever growing range of Proper Music Coasters we come to, arguably, one of the biggest stadium rock bands of the 80s and 90s - Bon Jovi. Famous in the 80s for their frankly hideous poodle-hairdos and their feel-good rock songs, they (in my opinion) hit their peak with 1991's album 'These Days'.  Never again have they quite hit those heights, and with the departure of guitarist (and, let's be honest, better singer) Richie Sambora they're not likely to again, but they still will always be on my playlist.  I saw them four times, including the last ever gig at the old Wembley Stadium in 2001.  Seriously, if you want a really good rock show then I can't recommend their gigs highly enough.
But go for the music, ladies.  We know you're all looking at Jon.....
This coaster is the cover of their 2005 album 'Have A Nice Day', a decent album and a good addition to the Bon Jovi pantheon.  It also has holes in the back for 3x5mm neodymium magnets (available separately in my store) so it can be retrofitted into a magnetic plaque or sign, or so it can be permanently mounted.  It can be ordered, printed and assembled, from my Etsy store - www.etsy.com/uk/shop/enterprisexddesign

description_text:
Baseball hat 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 27596 vertices, 27606 quad faces (55212 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text: A stopwatch is a handheld timepiece designed to measure the amount of time that elapses between its activation and deactivation. A large digital version of a stopwatch designed for viewing at a distance, as in a sports stadium, is called a stop clock. In manual timing, the clock is started and stopped by a person pressing a button. In fully automatic time, both starting and stopping are triggered automatically, by sensors. The timing functions are traditionally controlled by two buttons on the case. Pressing the top button starts the timer running, and pressing the button a second time stops it, leaving the elapsed time displayed. A press of the second button then resets the stopwatch to zero. The second button is also used to record split times or lap times. When the split time button is pressed while the watch is running it allows the elapsed time to that point to be read, but the watch mechanism continues running to record total elapsed time. Pressing the split button a second time allows the watch to resume display of total time.

description_text:
This is soccer ball made with Blender.
To make a ball I used icosphere. I reduce subdivision to 1 and then I add bevel modifier (increse the offset a little bit, then I add another bevel mod. and increse material to 2 and lower the offset value.Further I add sub surf. mod. and chenge it to simple, after that I added cast modifier and under factor value I change it to 1.After all of that I play with materials.
Enjoy. :)

FULL CGI 3DS MAX VRAY 3D model for Archviz. The project is a modern Stadium with contemporary facade design . description_text:
This model contains a detailed 3D model of a  sports stadium with 32,000 seats—perfect for architectural visualization, animations, and game environments. The model has been carefully optimized and structured, providing flexibility for different uses.  Blend file and FBX included. FBX file only has 1 stadium.
Features: 
  - Two Main Collections:

  - Stadium with Building: This collection includes the stadium fully enclosed by a realistic building, giving it a complete and polished look.

  - Stadium Without Building (No Building): A lighter version of the scene for users who want just the stadium structure without additional geometry.

  - You can also adjust the color of your seats by going to the shading tab and changing the color of the red plastic material.

Important: Turning on both collections simultaneously will result in a scene with over 6 million polygons, which may affect performance. By default, only one collection is enabled to ensure smooth navigation and rendering.

  -  Geometry:

  - 32,000 individual seats arranged in a realistic curved layout.

  - Stadium staircases and walkways 

  - Modular Design: 
  - Sections of seats and rows have been created using array modifiers, making it easy to modify or duplicate for custom projects.

  - Includes UV unwrapped models ready for texturing.

  - Scene Setup: 
  - Includes a pre-configured camera angle for rendering stunning visuals straight out of the box.

  - Ground plane and basic environmental setup included to streamline the workflow. 

  - Compatibility:

  - Created in Blender 3.x and fully compatible with newer versions.

  - All modifiers are non-destructive, so you can tweak arrays, curves, or scaling to suit your needs.

What’s Included:

  - blend file with:

  - Collection 1: Stadium + Building

  - Collection 2: Stadium Only

  - All textures used in the file (stadium seats, ground texture, etc.).

  - Pre-configured camera setup.

Use Cases:

  - Architectural visualization for sports venues or arenas.

  - CG animation and VFX shots requiring large-scale stadiums.

  - Game environments with modular seat arrangements.

  - Commercial projects needing realistic and detailed 3D stadiums.

  - Feel free to modify and customize the model to fit your project.

description_text:
A high-quality, ultra-realistic 3D model of a classic American hot dog, meticulously designed for food visualization, immersive game environments, and digital advertisements.
This asset features a grilled beef frankfurter nestled in a perfectly toasted top-split bun. It is richly detailed with textured condiments including a classic wavy line of yellow mustard and a drizzle of ketchup. Crucially, it includes finely rendered, individual chopped red onion cubes, adding a layer of authenticity that makes the food look fresh and appetizing. The PBR materials ensure that the greasy sheen on the meat, the texture of the bun, and the glossy nature of the condiments interact realistically with any lighting setup.
Designed as a standalone prop, this model is optimized for real-time performance. Its clean topology and high-resolution textures make it perfect for close-up renders and interactive applications.
Built with optimized topology and high-quality PBR-ready materials, this asset is ready for easy integration into Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, and other modern 3D pipelines.
Perfect For

  - Fast-food restaurant game environments

  - VR/AR cooking and dining simulations

  - Virtual hangout and social spaces

  - Architectural visualization (Kitchens, Dining areas, Patios)

  - Real-time cinematic background props

  - Digital menus and online food advertising

  - Food-themed mobile and casual games

  - Street food vendor scenes

  - Sports stadium concessions environments

  - Food truck visual projects

Features

  - Game-ready prop model with optimized topology

  - High-quality PBR-ready materials

  - Realistic grilled surface texture on frankfurter

  - Detailed condiments (Ketchup, Mustard, Chopped Onions)

  - Soft toasted bun texture

  - High-resolution texture maps (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion)

  - Clean UV unwrapping

  - Scaled to real-world dimensions

  - Easy integration for Unreal Engine and Unity

  - Low-poly efficiency for performance-heavy scenes

  - No text/branding for universal application

description_text:
Bring the lethal finishing power of England's star striker to your display shelf with this dynamic Harry Kane figurine, forged as a premium 3D print resin model ready for your brushstrokes. Capturing the focused intensity of the legendary forward advancing the play, this model is a perfect project for football fans and miniature painters alike.
While initially provided at a display-ready 290mm, you can effortlessly scale this 3D print resin model up or down to your own requirements in your slicer software.
Every realistic fold of the athletic jersey and the intricate stud detailing on the cleats of this 3D print resin model is meticulously engineered to be the ultimate canvas for your miniature painting skills.
We provide the physical 3D print resin model so that you can paint the iconic England national team colors, complete with the prominent number 9 on the chest and shorts, using your own custom palette.
This 3D print-ready resin figure acts as a professional-grade template for hobbyists to practice painting sports apparel fabrics, realistic skin tones, and bright athletic gear.
Transform this raw, unpainted 3D print resin model into a stadium-ready masterpiece by applying your favorite acrylic techniques to his athletic, striding stance and recognizable facial features.
The generous scale ensures every drop of paint you add to this 3D print resin model captures the competitive spirit of the beautiful game.
Included in this download:
Smooth Version: Features clean, sleek surfaces across the jersey, shorts, and socks. This is the ultimate blank 3D print resin model canvas for you to paint custom team logos, smooth fabric highlights, and personalized player numbers.
Textured Version: Includes finely sculpted fabric mesh grain on the athletic wear, realistic tension folds around the knees, and detailed textures on the modern cleats of the 3D print resin model. This version is perfectly optimized for you to paint using dry-brushing and high-contrast washes to make the sportswear details pop instantly.
File Format: High-resolution STL mesh, initially provided at 290mm but fully customizable to scale up or down to your own requirement before you print and paint the resin model.
3D Printing Settings
Recommended Printer Type: Resin (SLA/MSLA) is highly recommended for capturing his distinct facial hair, the prominent number 9, and the tiny studs on the cleats.
For Resin Printing:
Layer Height: 0.03mm to 0.05mm.
Hollowing: Recommended for the main torso and legs to save material; ensure drain holes are placed discretely under the soles of the cleats.
Supports: Medium supports for the main body structure; highly precise light supports for the fingers, the chin, and the edges of the athletic shorts.
For FDM Printing:
Layer Height: 0.12mm or lower.
Infill: 10% to 15% (Gyroid).
Walls: 3 to 4 perimeters.
Supports: Heavily required (especially for the overhanging arms, the chin, and the dynamic stride of the legs).
Recommended Materials: Standard Grey Resin or ABS-like Resin to create the best foundation for your paints and to provide crucial durability for the cleats and fingers.

description_text:
Create the illusion of a city beyond the boundaries of your game.
This pack contains:
27 materials18 meshes17 prefabs
Building textures are 2048x2048 by default but can be scaled down safely for further optimisation.
This package was made with Unity 5, however can easily be used in your game engine of choice.The lamp, road/sidewalk and railings are all included and use a PBR gloss setup. To use roughness instead simply invert the colours of the gloss map. (Ctrl-I in photoshop) Gloss is stored in the alpha channel of the metalness map.
The file formats are .fbx and .png
The lighting effects of the street lamps however were made with light flares from the unity standard assets.

description_text:
Double street light 3D Model. 2 individual objects (street light pole, glasses), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 40118 vertices, 40112 quad faces (80224 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Road blocks
Road blocks model
Blocks Description
The 3D models were created on real details base. 
Lowpoly , game assets. Models were made in Blender! They have  diffuse (color), normal, specular and normal detail  in Png and jpg format. Models are centered and pivot point is aligned . They have very detailed texture maps and could also be used for some medium close-up shots and renders. Textures are in zip file.
Model formats: 

  - *.Blend (Blender) 

  - *.3Ds 

  - *.fbx 

  - *.mtl 

  - *.obj 

  - *.dxf 

  - All texture is included in the set. 

  - renders Are made in Blender If you need any other formats I am more than happy to make them for you. The model is provided combined, all main parts are presented as separate parts therefore materials of objects are easy to be modified or removed and standard parts are easy to be replaced. If you experience difficulties with separating standard parts I am more than happy to give you qualified assistance. I greatly appreciate you choosing my 3D models and hope they will be of use. I look forward to continuously dealing with you. Enjoy it!

Sincerely Yours,
Luca

description_text:
The Metropolitan Life Insurance Company Tower, known also as the Metropolitan Life South Building or simply the Met Life Tower, is a 700ft (213m) tall skyscraper in New York City. Completed in 1913, the building is among the oldest major skyscrapers in the city. Once the tallest building in the world, the Met Life Building still towers over its immediate surroundings, which most notably includes the world-famous Madison Square Park. The tower was designed by Napoleon LeBrun & Sons as a modern adaptation of Venice's St Mark's Campanile. Its height, classic design, large clockface, and brilliant lighting at night have made this building among New York City's most enduring landmarks.
NOTES:

  - In 1964, the Renaissance-Revival ornamentation was largely removed from the tower, replacing it with flat limestone as a modernization renovation. This model aims to recreate the building as it was designed with all its original ornamentation.

  - A model of this building was first uploaded in 2019. A new, much improved version of the model was created from scratch in 2022

description_text:
Thank you for checking out Greeble city!
Includes collection of low-poly modular building objects  that can be used to assemble buildings, city environments and cityscapes.
Features:

  -  Optimized - shared materials, low-poly game engine ready.

  -  Pieces easily fit together using a grid and allows for highly customizable and flexible layouts to fit any level.

  -  Perfect for backgrounds, distant city scapes or plantes and filler environments.

  -  Polygon count range: 134 - 732

Included 4k texture maps:

  -  Diffuse

  -  Metal/Smoothness (RGBA)

  -  Normal

  -  Emission

Note: Render scene/layout NOT included
Unity3d ready asset package can be found here- https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/environments/sci-fi/greeble-city-174110
Reviews/feedback are always appreciated and helps me to improve and create higher quality assets. Thanks!

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render.   - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.
